def factor_close_loc_align_ewm(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    close_loc = (df_copy["close"] - df_copy["low"]) / range_.replace(0, np.nan)
    close_loc = close_loc - 0.5
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol = df_copy["volume"]
    vwap_ret_num = (vol * ret).ewm(span=10, min_periods=1).mean()
    vwap_ret_den = vol.ewm(span=10, min_periods=1).mean().replace(0, np.nan)
    vwap_ret = vwap_ret_num / vwap_ret_den
    ewma_ret = ret.ewm(span=10, min_periods=1).mean()
    ratio = (1 + vwap_ret) / (1 + ewma_ret).replace(0, np.nan) - 1
    factor = close_loc * (1 + ratio)
    factor = factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_close_loc_align_ewm"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_close_loc_align_ewm"]
description: Mutation of parent price-volume coherence factor. Replaces rolling window (20-day) volume-weighted and equal-weighted returns with exponential moving averages (span=10) to increase responsiveness to recent volume flows. The core economic mechanism remains: intraday close location is amplified when volume confirms price direction, captured via ratio of volume-weighted to equal-weighted returns. The shorter adaptive lookback may improve rank stability and density.
